description:
src/methods/mod.rs has a 6-line file-top comment summarizing the module, but no `//!` doc-comment on the module itself. Consequence: rustdoc generates a 'Modules' page for jmap_calendars_client::methods with no description. Public types (GetResponse, SetResponse, etc.) have type-level docs, so the page is functional, but a single-line `//!` summary at the top of mod.rs would help.

Comparable: src/methods/event_parse.rs:1 already does `//! CalendarEvent/parse method (draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.13).`. The other methods/*.rs files use `//` line comments instead — inconsistent.

Trivial fix; flag as Section 4 readability.

Files with `//` comments instead of `//!` modules docs:
- src/methods/mod.rs:1
- src/methods/calendar.rs:1
- src/methods/event.rs:1
- src/methods/event_copy.rs:1
- src/methods/event_notification.rs:1
- src/methods/participant_identity.rs:1

Files using `//!`:
- src/methods/event_parse.rs:1
- src/methods/principal_availability.rs:1
- src/lib.rs:1
